entries.mem0ai/mem0: This universal memory layer provides multi-level storage for user, session, and agent states using temporal reasoning and multi-signal retrieval. It is an official Hermes Agent provider available as a managed cloud service or an Apache-2.0 self-hosted SDK.
entries.volcengine/OpenViking: OpenViking organizes agent context as a virtual filesystem using viking:// URIs and a three-tier loading system to achieve significant token reduction. This official Hermes provider archives sessions as editable Markdown files and reported a 43-49% task-completion gain in LoCoMo10 testing.
entries.topoteretes/cognee: Cognee is a self-hosted knowledge graph engine that builds persistent long-term memory from text, code, and conversations. It supports local extraction and embedding models to distill session lessons into searchable permanent memory without requiring LLM API keys.
entries.supermemoryai/supermemory: This official Hermes provider features a custom vector graph engine capable of sub-300ms recall at scales exceeding 100B tokens per month. It maintains auto-updated user profiles and supports multi-modal extraction from PDFs, images, and videos with byte-level deduplication.
entries.garrytan/gbrain: Gbrain focuses on institutional memory by storing portable, explicit facts with provenance across multiple agents. It utilizes scoped access controls and extracts typed entity edges without the need for LLM calls.
entries.vectorize-io/hindsight: Hindsight implements long-term retain, recall, and reflect workflows through an LLM wrapper designed for disposition-aware response generation. It supports Python, Node.js, and Go clients with deployment options for Docker, Kubernetes, and bare metal.
entries.plastic-labs/honcho: Honcho is a FastAPI-based memory library that serves as the upstream foundation for the elkimek/honcho-self-hosted Hermes wrapper. It provides Python and TypeScript SDKs to support managed, local, and self-hosted deployment of stateful agents.
entries.campfirein/byterover-cli: This official Hermes provider manages context as a git-like repository, offering version control features like branching and merging over a markdown context tree. It utilizes a 5-tier retrieval system where four tiers are non-LLM based, achieving sub-100ms performance.
entries.mnemosyne-oss/mnemosyne: Mnemosyne is a zero-dependency system that uses a single SQLite database to provide sub-millisecond memory access for Hermes Agents. It includes episodic compression to ensure sub-linear storage growth and integrates via MCP, Python SDK, or OpenWebUI.
entries.ClaudioDrews/memory-os: Memory-os utilizes a seven-layer system including vector search on Qdrant and an auto-curated wiki to manage agent memory. It employs a Ground Truth hierarchy to ensure the agent prioritizes injected context within its local Docker-based infrastructure.
entries.greyhaven-ai/autocontext: This recursive self-improving harness uses filesystem-first artifacts like playbooks and context bundles to help agents manage complex tasks. It supports Python and TypeScript surfaces and integrates with MCP clients and self-hosted OpenAI-compatible endpoints.
entries.stephenschoettler/hermes-lcm: Hermes-lcm is a lossless context management plugin that uses a hierarchical DAG and SQLite store to ensure no messages are lost. It provides specialized recall tools like lcm_grep and lcm_recall for recovering specific details from the message history.
entries.vshulcz/deja-vu: This tool automatically indexes history from 34 different coding agents to enable millisecond natural-language searches over months of past sessions. It ensures safety by redacting keys and tokens during the indexing process of gigabytes of history.
entries.elkimek/honcho-self-hosted: This self-hosted backend provides private cross-session memory for Hermes Agent using any OpenAI-compatible provider or local inference server. It includes an automated setup script for deploying Docker, PostgreSQL, and Redis environments.
entries.plur-ai/plur: Plur implements a shared memory layer that stores plain-text YAML engrams on local disk for multi-agent systems. It utilizes hybrid retrieval via BM25 and local embeddings, offering an MCP server for tool portability.
entries.Signet-AI/signetai: Signet-AI is a local-first identity and memory layer that syncs state across Hermes Agent, Claude Code, and other harnesses with 97.6% LongMemEval benchmark accuracy. It supports real-time data ingestion from platforms including Obsidian, Discord, and GitHub.
entries.yoloshii/ClawMem: This on-device context engine operates entirely locally without cloud dependencies or API keys. It integrates via MCP and plugins, employing a hybrid retrieval system that combines BM25 and vector search.
entries.Sibyl-Labs/Sibyl-Memory: Sibyl-Memory provides durable, file-based storage using a five-tier hierarchical SQLite schema and FTS5 search. The architecture is notable for requiring zero vector databases and zero embedding models to function.
entries.EfficientContext/ContextPilot: This optimization tool reduces prefill latency by 1.5–3× and saves up to 36% of tokens through block reordering and deduplication. It features native plugin support for the Hermes Agent and OpenClaw ecosystems to accelerate long-context inference.
entries.yantrikos/yantrikdb-hermes-plugin: This self-maintaining plugin provides explainable retrieval by attaching a 'why_retrieved' tag to every result. It includes primitives for tracking contradictions and a self-directing loop to identify and queue knowledge gaps.
entries.ccf/agentcairn: Agentcairn uses an Obsidian vault as a source of truth, storing durable memory as inspectable Markdown files with frontmatter metadata. It avoids opaque databases in favor of a local DuckDB cache for hybrid search across coding projects.
entries.JanYork/llm-wiki-cli: This CLI maintains agent-driven wikis featuring citations, links, and provenance for source-grounded knowledge. It uses SQLite for storage and supports portable archives for importing or merging wiki data across sessions.
entries.amanning3390/flowstate-qmd: Flowstate-qmd features an anticipatory cache that prefetches context by monitoring agent session logs. It is an MCP-native server that utilizes SQLite-vec and GGUF models for local-first storage and retrieval.
entries.yepyhun/Brainstack: Brainstack integrates Hindsight, Graphiti, and MemPalace into a single memory owner for the Hermes agent. It manages state and retrieval using SQLite, Kuzu, and Chroma to deliver purpose-built evidence packets for every query.
entries.Perseus-Computing-LLC/perseus: This context layer resolves live workspace states into verified facts to ensure agents only load necessary data. It features local-first session tracking and supports MCP-native integration via stdio or SSE servers.
entries.generalbusiness-ai/keep: This reflective memory system utilizes BM25 full-text search and ranked graph traversal for information retrieval. It automates indexing for codebases and multimedia using OCR and edge tags to create bidirectional relationships between notes.
entries.alias8818/hermes-tool-slimmer: Designed for Hermes Agent v0.14.0, this tool reduces prompt token overhead through local BM25 tool ranking. It includes a dedicated dashboard to track estimated schema token savings and supports native tool search.
entries.conorbronsdon/claude-context-os: This Git-backed workflow layer manages context for coding agents like Claude Code and Codex using hash-checked proposals. It provides a source-neutral migration path for exporting chats and documents into a reviewed context structure.
entries.Ladybug-Memory/hermes-memory-plugin: This local-only plugin uses a single .lbdb embedded graph database to store memories with a 1-10 importance ranking. It prioritizes high-value information during context prefetch using BM25 keyword search and named graph relationships.
entries.MukundaKatta/hermes-agentmemory: This episodic memory plugin features a pull-model that supports immediate event deletion and an on-demand summarizer. It maintains a trace.jsonl audit log to provide a transparent record of every memory and prefetch operation.
entries.piprail/piprail: This TypeScript SDK and MCP server enables agents to manage budget-bound wallets for x402 payments across EVM and Solana chains. The system operates without a backend, database, or API keys to facilitate autonomous financial transactions.
entries.stepanov1975/hermes-local-knowledge: This plugin indexes local skills, runbooks, and scripts to provide tools for knowledge search and neighbor traversal. It supports automatic tool-OKF generation via detached model calls to streamline local capability routing.
entries.yonro/hermes-xmemo-plugin: This provider enables cross-session continuity by allowing agents to read memories from other connected agents. It utilizes native lifecycle hooks for session snapshots and a local SQLite layer for reliable caching and write outbox management.
entries.futurebrowser/hermes-exabase-plugin: Integrating Exabase M-1, this plugin provides self-organizing long-term memory for Hermes agents. It includes tools for manual memory storage and supports configurable query expansion and result reranking for retrieval.
entries.sourcevault-ai/sourcevault-code-tools: This plugin provides private local code memory for repositories through deterministic slash commands and LLM-callable tools. It requires a local SourceVault server to handle indexing, vector storage, and grounded Q&A.
entries.visorcraft/MongrelDB-Hermes: This long-term memory solution features AES-256-GCM encryption at rest and multiple retrieval modes including HNSW ANN and FM-index. It can be executed via native Rust FFI or as an HTTP daemon, supporting metadata filters and MinHash deduplication.
entries.penfieldlabs/hermes-penfield: This provider offers 17 specialized tools for memory management and knowledge graph traversal using a hybrid search approach that combines BM25, vector, and graph methods. It maintains agent continuity by performing automatic context checkpointing during message compression.
entries.conorbronsdon/agent-memory-kit: This toolkit implements a file-based memory hygiene loop that uses a git-backed directory for versioned, diffable markdown storage without a database. It features dedicated 'rot' and 'lint' curators to identify stale or conflicting data, providing evidence-cited diffs for manual review via five slash commands.

entries.obra/superpowers: This framework implements a software development methodology centered on TDD, YAGNI, and DRY principles. It automates implementation planning and specification elicitation while supporting integration with multiple CLI tools and coding harnesses.
entries.nexu-io/open-design: A local-first system for generating web, mobile, and motion graphic artifacts with native support for the Hermes Agent runtime. It allows agents to export designs into multiple formats including HTML, PDF, PPTX, and MP4.
entries.mukul975/Anthropic-Cybersecurity-Skills: This library provides 818 structured skills across 34 security domains, mapped to frameworks like MITRE ATT&CK, NIST CSF 2.0, and ATLAS. It is compatible with over 26 AI platforms to enhance agent capabilities in cybersecurity tasks.
entries.Agents365-ai/drawio-skill: This skill enables agents to convert codebases, schemas, and infrastructure-as-code into draw.io diagrams via natural language. It supports incremental synchronization to preserve manual layouts and includes an optional MCP server.
entries.internet-court/internet-court-skill: Serving as a trust layer for agent-to-agent commerce, this skill facilitates natural-language mandates, escrow, and dispute resolution. it utilizes ERC-7710 delegated permissions and x402 payments to manage secure transactions.
entries.conorbronsdon/avoid-ai-writing: This tool audits and rewrites content to eliminate detectable AI patterns using a 112-entry word replacement table. It features three operational modes and optional voice profiles for casual, professional, or technical tones.
entries.AMAP-ML/SkillClaw: This agentic evolver automates skill deduplication and cross-pollination across isolated agent silos. It integrates with Hermes and other OpenAI-compatible APIs, providing a bilingual dashboard for inspecting session traces.
entries.wondelai/skills: A cross-platform library featuring 51 expert frameworks and 14 guided metaskills compatible with the agent-plugins.org specification. It maintains session state locally within the project's documentation folder to support persistent agent workflows.
entries.mohitagw15856/pm-claude-skills: This collection offers 1,170 markdown-based skills for professional and personal tasks that run natively in Hermes Agent. The skills operate without telemetry or mandatory user accounts and are exportable to various other AI assistants.
entries.ZeroPointRepo/youtube-skills: This plugin grants agents the ability to search YouTube, browse channels, and extract transcripts or playlist data. It is compatible with Hermes Agent and OpenClaw, requiring a TranscriptAPI key for operation.
entries.Romanescu11/hermes-skill-factory: A meta-skill plugin that monitors active workflows to automatically detect and propose reusable skills. It generates both SKILL.md documentation and Python plugin scaffolds to streamline the creation of new agent capabilities.
entries.Cranot/super-hermes: These skills enable Hermes Agent to generate its own custom thinking instructions and analytical prompts for specific tasks. The system includes pre-built analytical lenses and generates reports that highlight potential analysis blind spots.
entries.DougTrajano/pydantic-ai-skills: This project enables type-safe support for agentskills.io registries using Git and S3 sources. It provides sandboxed execution to isolate untrusted scripts from the host while offering tools for reading bundled resources.
entries.tlehman/litprog-skill: This skill implements literate programming by generating documents that combine prose, diagrams, and source code. It features a tangler to extract runnable files and automatically syncs edits back to the original documentation.
entries.AkoliteZA/hermes-agent-idea-workflow: This workflow converts rough ideas into structured design and implementation documents through Lite and Full complexity modes. It ensures quality via a spec review gate utilizing PASS/FAIL evaluation models.
entries.ReinaMacCredy/maestro: Running on Bun, this harness implements the SLP v2 protocol for supervised cooperative-agent teams. It manages work and evidence through a CLI-driven mechanism kernel without requiring background services.
entries.esaradev/icarus-plugin: This plugin facilitates cross-instance shared memory using markdown files to capture high-value decisions and outcomes. It includes a specialized pipeline for fine-tuning and switching to replacement models.
entries.Hermes-brasil/hermes-brasil: This community resource provides agentskills.io-compatible skills and guides for production tasks like VPS hosting and cron automation. It supports localized integrations for platforms including Telegram, Discord, Slack, and WhatsApp.
entries.smartcontractkit/chainlink-agent-skills: These developer tools follow the Agent Skills specification to enable interactions with oracle networks and smart contracts. Supported integrations include CCIP, VRF, Data Feeds, and Data Streams via the Vercel CLI.
entries.black-forest-labs/skills: This official suite provides eight specialist skills for FLUX image and video generation, including prompting guidelines and API integration. It supports BFL API features such as polling and webhooks for media generation workflows.
entries.armelhbobdad/bmad-module-skill-forge: This tool converts repositories, documentation, and developer discourse into compliant skills by linking instructions to specific file lines. It features automated workflows for the entire lifecycle of briefing, creating, testing, and exporting skills.
entries.supernovae-st/nika: Nika is a local-first workflow language that uses four core verbs—infer, invoke, exec, and agent—to define intent as code. It generates local traces and verification journals for every run and is distributed via shell, Homebrew, npm, and Nix.
entries.chigwell/skilldock.io: This registry offers reusable AI skills with a Python client and CLI that supports recursive dependency resolution. It also incorporates commerce features through the use of TON payments.
entries.tiann/execplan-skill: Designed for complex multi-step tasks, this skill provides autonomous execution with real-time tracking of progress and decisions. It ensures operational safety through built-in rollback procedures and recovery checkpoints.
entries.adnw-vinc/hermes-nextcloud: This skill enables Hermes Agent to manage files, calendars, tasks, and contacts through standard WebDAV and CalDAV protocols. It ensures secure communication over HTTPS using Nextcloud App Passwords and includes a guided setup script for credential validation.
entries.amanning3390/hermeshub: Serving as a community hub for skill discovery and one-click installation, this project implements the Agentic Resource Discovery (ARD) v0.9 specification. It operates autonomously on NVIDIA infrastructure and provides federated search integration across GitHub and Hugging Face.
entries.cablate/Agentic-MCP-Skill: This progressive MCP client utilizes a three-layer lazy loading architecture to minimize token usage during skill discovery. It features a socket-based daemon for persistent connections and incrementally discovers server metadata and tool schemas.
entries.willingning-coder/eagle-eye: This project implements a five-layer retrieval system using hard triggers, semantic embeddings, and RRF fusion to narrow skill lists before LLM calls. By filtering relevant skills, it reduces token usage and offers graceful degradation if specific embedding models are unavailable.
entries.EntangledQuantum/Life_OS: Designed as an ADHD-friendly execution system, this project provides agent-driven scheduling and habit tracking via an MCP connection. It stores all data locally in a single SQLite file and includes both a React web application and an Expo-based Android app.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermaguard: This read-only code review skill employs three parallel subagents to perform adversarial attacks and edge-case analysis on code. It combines deterministic pre-scans using tools like Semgrep and Bandit with verified findings through proof-of-concept execution in a hardened sandbox.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermes-multichannel-prompt-opt: This plugin optimizes and scores prompts across various interfaces like Discord and Telegram, supporting 97 different languages. It aims to reduce token usage by 20–80% per rewrite while evaluating prompt quality across five distinct dimensions.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermes-simplify-swarm: Inspired by Claude Code, this skill uses a swarm of three sub-agents focused on hygiene, clarity, and correctness to simplify codebases. It supports multiple languages including Python and Rust, utilizing a tiered application process with a mandatory approval gate.
entries.teixeirazeus/fablize-for-hermes: This project adapts verified procedures for task decomposition and evidence-based verification gates to prevent early-stop errors. It includes a systematic investigation protocol for causal debugging and a Python goal engine for persistent task state management.
entries.PederHP/skillsdotnet: This C# and .NET implementation of the agentskills.io pattern enables tool-based skill loading via Microsoft.Extensions.AI. It supports progressive disclosure through SKILL.md files and provides automatic registration for common agent skill directories.
entries.handnewb/hermes-cybersec-lab: This turnkey cybersecurity lab equips Hermes Agent with over 2,000 skills and 131 tools for forensics, networking, and exploitation. It integrates 28 frameworks, including MITRE ATT&CK and NIST, to address real-world exploits spanning from 2015 to 2026.
entries.conorbronsdon/agent-skills: This suite provides production-tested tools for session management and worktree recovery to maintain memory between agent conversations. It also orchestrates parallel subagents for architectural reviews and includes scaffolding for developing new skills.
entries.Diabloluo/hermes-hud: This local-first dashboard provides real-time observability for Hermes Agent across 11 monitoring tabs, including token costs, session history, and error tracking. It enforces a strict read-only boundary with zero outbound telemetry and can optionally send incident alerts to Telegram or Feishu.
entries.conorbronsdon/demo-gif-skill: This skill automates the creation of reproducible recording scripts and optimized GIFs for repository READMEs using vhs or Playwright. It manages the entire pipeline from rendering and compression to embedding the final markdown, targeting file sizes under 8 MB.
entries.aidevelopers2/remoteopenclaw-mcp: This tool enables users to search a database of over 13,870 MCP servers and 4,384 agent skills directly from the terminal or an AI agent. It provides installation commands for discovered plugins and integrates with MCP-compatible clients like Hermes, Cursor, and Claude Code.
entries.conorbronsdon/agent-skill-builder: This utility generates Claude Code and portable agent skills from plain language while validating them against runtime-specific profiles. It prevents specification drift by monitoring official frontmatter requirements weekly and providing CI-friendly exit codes for validation failures.
entries.Carlo1911/skill-evolution: This host-agnostic framework creates a self-improvement loop by analyzing session history to propose skill coverage gaps. It operates locally using the Python standard library and gates all updates behind deterministic, LLM-judge, and regression evaluators.
entries.jiawood2006/hermes-skills: This collection provides specialized tools for transcribing Douyin videos, removing Chinese AI writing patterns, and performing OCR on PDFs and images. It utilizes a rule-based engine for text refinement and macOS Vision for structured data extraction.
entries.CorsenAI/hermes-windows-runtime-skills: These skills enable deterministic path routing and Python interpreter selection across Windows, Git Bash/MSYS, and WSL environments. The project ensures file operations use environment-specific syntax and verifies project-compatible runtimes without requiring new installations.
entries.superagnt/leverage: This project offers a suite of skills for social data enrichment, web scraping, and lead prospecting compatible with agentskills.io clients. It includes packaged workflows for SEO and content automation, supported by MCP server integration and workspace Postgres capabilities.
entries.mag3nt-com/openclaw-skill: This skill automates payments for HTTP 402 responses using USDC across protocols like Pay Link, x402, and MPP. It is designed for compatibility with OpenClaw, Hermes Agent, and the agentskills.io standard.
entries.skillseal/skillseal: This project certifies the quality of AI agent skills by testing their structure, functionality, and security within isolated Docker containers. It issues cryptographically verifiable certificates using Ed25519 signatures and provides a public API for verification.
entries.webmilmind1/hermes-bounty-board: This plugin allows users to earn USDC on the Base network by answering support bounties over x402 without requiring an account or API key. It includes tools for managing bounty boards and context, with payments distributed automatically upon human approval.
entries.scavio-ai/hermes-agent: This project provides access to structured web data across 31 platforms through a hosted MCP server exposing 191 tools. It includes five production-grade workflow skills compatible with Hermes, Claude, Cursor, Goose, and OpenHands.
entries.Shine8592/china-briefing: This project provides Hermes Agent with a multi-scale Chinese news briefing skill that processes information ranging from global events to street-level updates. It utilizes semantic memory to align search expansion with user interests, producing structured reports that include core conclusions and actionable suggestions.

entries.numtide/llm-agents.nix: This project provides daily-updated Nix packages for AI coding agents, including Hermes and tools from major providers like OpenAI and Google. It serves as a specialized distribution layer for users who require reproducible development environments and automated package maintenance.
entries.marshallrichards/ClawPhone: ClawPhone offers an automated installer and configuration guides for running the Antigravity CLI and OpenClaw on ARM64 Android devices via Termux. It enables hardware and UI interaction by leveraging Termux:API and Termux:GUI for mobile agent operations.
entries.AbuZar-Ansarii/Hermes-Agent-On-Android: This repository features a Termux-based automated installation script that utilizes proot-distro Ubuntu to run Hermes Agent on Android. The setup supports shell command execution and interactive model configuration through both external providers and local Ollama instances.
entries.ultraworkers/hermes-agent-helm-chart: This community Helm chart facilitates the deployment of Hermes Agent on Kubernetes with a focus on cloud-native state safety. It enforces single-writer access for persistent storage and supports both direct deployments and operator-ready CRD workflows.
entries.amirghm/hermes-agent-mobile: Providing a one-command installer for both Android and iOS, this project brings Hermes to mobile platforms via Termux and iSH. It distinguishes itself by integrating with Telegram for voice and file messaging and supporting scheduled tasks through cron jobs.
entries.TheAiSingularity/hermesclaw: Hermesclaw focuses on high-security deployments by implementing hardware-enforced sandboxing via NVIDIA OpenShell. It provides kernel-level restrictions on network and filesystem access, allowing for granular security policies regarding web searches and messaging.
entries.solomon2773/nora: Nora is a self-hosted control plane designed to deploy and monitor Hermes agents across Docker and Kubernetes environments. It features a 69-entry credential catalog, support for over 17 LLM providers, and mandatory AES-256-GCM encryption for all secrets.
entries.xmbshwll/hermes-agent-docker: This project provides a straightforward Docker sandbox image that bundles the official Hermes installation with mini-swe-agent. It supports persistent state through mounted directories and allows users to target specific Hermes versions using build arguments.
entries.0xrsydn/nix-hermes-agent: This NixOS module enables declarative configuration of Hermes Agent deployments, including workspace documents and CLI settings. It offers a hybrid skill management system and integrates with sops-nix for secure handling of secrets via systemd.
entries.jpalmae/hermeshq: HermesHQ acts as a Docker-first control plane for managing multiple agent instances with separate workspaces and RBAC-controlled access. The platform supports inter-agent delegation with hierarchy-aware communication and enterprise MCP access for external clients.
entries.JackTheGit/hermes-autonomous-server: Targeting production environments on Ubuntu and Debian, this project configures the Hermes Gateway as a reboot-safe systemd service. It is designed for headless operation, enabling the autonomous execution of recurring AI cron jobs and Nous Portal integration.
entries.MilkyWay008/Hermes-OTG: Hermes OTG is a portable distribution that runs from external drives without requiring host installation or registry modifications. It bundles Python, PortableGit, and rescue tools to support Desktop, TUI, and Gateway modes in offline or isolated environments.

entries.TauricResearch/TradingAgents: This framework organizes specialized agents into a multi-tier structure of researchers, traders, and portfolio managers for financial analysis. It enables backtesting across various LLM providers and data vendors to evaluate fundamental, sentiment, and technical trading strategies.
entries.builderz-labs/mission-control: This self-hosted orchestration platform governs agent registration, task dispatching, and cost tracking through a centralized Web UI or CLI. It supports multi-agent workflows with integrated memory browsing and can be deployed locally via Node.js or Docker.
entries.agent-of-empires/agent-of-empires: This control surface manages multiple coding agents, including Hermes Agent, using tmux for persistent background execution and Docker for sandboxed environments. Users can monitor agent activity and review code diffs through both TUI and web-based dashboards.
entries.CryptoDmitry/hermes-agent-control-room: This execution engine is the first to manage Hermes agents on the Solana blockchain while supporting the Claude-style MCP protocol in stdio mode. It features specialized detection for HTTP signals to handle payment-required states for paid API services.
entries.shannhk/hermes-agent-control-room: Utilizing a level-based architecture, this template scales Hermes Agent from single VPS instances to automated teams using a task bus pattern for delegation. It includes bundled skills for infrastructure tasks such as security auditing, VPS provisioning, and backup management.
entries.swarmclawai/swarmclaw: This framework facilitates the creation of autonomous agent swarms with durable memory and support for over 23 LLM providers. It features visual org charts to manage agent team delegation and integrates with MCP tools for expanded capabilities.
entries.agent37-platform/minions: This mission control interface provides a Kanban board and live streaming of agent reasoning to supervise autonomous Hermes Agent tasks. It emphasizes human-in-the-loop verification, requiring manual approval for all agent-proposed task completions.
entries.1ilkhamov/opencode-hermes-multiagent: This system employs a strict pipeline architecture to coordinate 17 specialized agents across research, planning, and infrastructure domains. A Master Orchestrator manages the routing and coordination of these agents to ensure structured task execution.
entries.linke-ai/hermes-agent-team: This local collaboration system orchestrates Leader and Specialist agents using Hermes Agent profiles and a real-time Web UI. It integrates MCP and ACP protocols to handle local tools and communication throughout the automated task lifecycle.
entries.howdymary/hermes-agent-metaharness: This meta-harness automates the outer-loop optimization of benchmark code for Hermes Agent, referencing Arxiv research for its methodology. It orchestrates TBLite and TerminalBench-2 evaluations while tracking candidate mutations and frontier progress.
entries.runtimenoteslabs/gladiator: This arena orchestrates nine autonomous agents across two competing AI companies to track performance metrics and GitHub star growth. It utilizes Hermes Agent for task execution and provides a real-time dashboard to visualize code and scoreboard data.
entries.InfiniteWhispers/HermesAgent-MultiModel: Optimized for consumer GPUs, this fully-local framework implements a Mixture-of-Agents stack using Hermes for task routing and tool-calling. It eliminates cloud dependencies by running parallel model querying and synthesis via Ollama.

entries.colbymchenry/codegraph: This tool provides a local, Rust-powered code knowledge graph that integrates with Hermes Agent via an MCP server to reduce token usage. It maintains index accuracy by automatically syncing data on every file change to prevent stale results.
entries.junhoyeo/tokscale: Tokscale is a CLI utility that tracks token consumption and costs for Hermes Agent and other AI tools through a TUI and 3D visualization dashboard. Users can monitor their usage data locally or submit it to a public leaderboard and profile.
entries.liaohch3/claude-tap: This local trace viewer allows developers to inspect API traffic from Hermes Agent and other coding tools while redacting authentication headers for security. It generates self-contained HTML viewers for exported sessions, facilitating detailed analysis of agent interactions.
entries.Javis603/token-monitor: This widget provides real-time tracking of token limits and costs by reading Hermes Agent state directly alongside other CLI tools. It supports multi-device synchronization and offers historical usage trends broken down by project or session.
entries.bergside/typeui: TypeUI offers design systems and layout guidance through MCP servers compatible with Hermes Agent and other markdown-supporting AI providers. It assists developers in building better user interfaces by providing structured design constraints within the agent workflow.
entries.Salomondiei08/oh-my-hermes: This opinionated workflow layer coordinates seven specialized agents, such as CTO and Builder, to autonomously build and ship applications using Hermes Agent. It includes 36 skills for deployment and monitoring, requiring human approval only for irreversible actions.
entries.joeynyc/hermes-skins: This project enables visual customization of the Hermes terminal UI through YAML-based themes and community-created skins. Users can modify ASCII art banners, spinners, and colors to achieve aesthetics ranging from retro DOS to cyberpunk.
entries.tinyhumansai/tiny.place: Tiny.place establishes a social economy for autonomous agents by providing encrypted messaging via Signal Protocol and identity registration with human-readable handles. It facilitates agent-to-agent commerce using Solana-based USDC and SOL payments.
entries.AlexAI-MCP/hermes-CCC: This port brings the Hermes Agent brain and 46 native skills directly into the Claude Code Channel without requiring external processes or OAuth. It includes specialized MLOps tools for vLLM inference, GGUF management, and reinforcement learning training.
entries.unmodeled-tyler/vessel-browser: Vessel is an AI-native browser designed for autonomous agent control, featuring a supervisor sidebar for managing approvals and checkpoints. It supports external MCP clients and provides built-in integration for various AI providers to facilitate browser automation.
entries.topoteretes/cognee-integrations: This project provides memory integrations for various frameworks using a two-tier system of knowledge graphs and session caches. It enables persistent memory across platforms like Slack, Telegram, and VS Code for agents built with tools like LangGraph or CrewAI.
entries.adityahimaone/hermes-agent-rtk-caveman: This setup utilizes RTK and Caveman templating to achieve 90-99% token savings during Hermes Agent workflows. It comes with over 40 pre-configured skills for finance and DevOps, supported by an automated installer for macOS and Linux.
entries.hermes-labs-ai/lintlang: This static linter performs deterministic analysis of agent configurations, tool descriptions, and system prompts using HERM v1.1 scoring. It integrates into CI workflows via GitHub Actions, pre-commit hooks, and SARIF output to scan Markdown, JSON, YAML, and Python files.
entries.Abruptive/Ankh.md: Ankh.md is a TAW Agent framework that enables per-folder scoping for Hermes Agents with local configuration and skills. It allows users to switch between default and scoped agents while supporting project-local memories, tools, and custom instructions.
entries.42-evey/evey-setup: This tool automates the installation of a hermes-agent stack and 12+ supporting services across three scalable deployment tiers. It provides a zero-cost setup that includes support for 29 community plugins categorized into six functional areas.
entries.0xNyk/openclaw-to-hermes: This migration utility transitions OpenClaw environments to Hermes Agent by mapping SOUL.md, MEMORY.md, and skills into Hermes YAML and JSON formats. It also handles nested auth structures and sets up systemd gateway services for the migrated agent.
entries.observeco/observeco: Observeco provides self-healing observability for multi-agent systems through a native Hermes plugin that exports real-time telemetry without cloud dependencies. It uses zero-token passive analysis and active probing to detect performance drift relative to local file changes.
entries.33hodl/hermes-startup: This project provides a deterministic zero-network local runtime designed to help users generate revenue using Hermes Agent. It features a safety-first architecture that requires explicit approval for all external writes and consequential actions through specific contract modules.
entries.handnewb/hermes-voice: Hermes-voice adds a fully local, offline voice interface to the agent featuring wake-word activation and adaptive turn-taking. It supports 35 languages via Piper and 9 via Kokoro without requiring API keys or external accounts.
entries.181079342/hermes-memoss: This memory plugin for Hermes supports multi-dimensional storage and semantic search for managing agent information. It includes dedicated tools for searching, adding, and deleting memories, alongside a circuit breaker to handle MemOS API outages.

entries.farion1231/cc-switch: This cross-platform manager, built on the Tauri 2 framework, supports Windows, macOS, and Linux. It serves as an all-in-one interface for managing configurations across multiple agentic tools and CLI interfaces, including Hermes Agent and Claude Code.
entries.iOfficeAI/AionUi: AionUi is a local cowork application that enables autonomous multi-step tasks with file access and user approval for agents like Hermes Agent and Claude Code. It supports both built-in and external agents while providing remote access through a WebUI and messaging platforms like Telegram.
entries.nesquena/hermes-webui: Developed with Python and vanilla JavaScript, this interface allows users to access Hermes Agent from web browsers or mobile devices. It features a circular context ring for monitoring token usage and supports secure remote access via SSH tunnels.
entries.fathah/hermes-desktop: This desktop companion app simplifies the deployment of Hermes Agent through guided installation and provider setup. It provides a dedicated GUI for managing chat sessions, tools, and multiple AI providers.
entries.EKKOLearnAI/hermes-studio: This web dashboard offers unified configuration for ten communication platforms, including WhatsApp and Matrix, across various runtimes like Hermes and DeepSeek Harness. It features a visual workflow builder with cron-based scheduling, approval gates, and usage analytics.
entries.outsourc-e/hermes-workspace: This native web workspace includes a Monaco-based file browser, a PTY terminal, and a skills manager with an MCP catalog. It supports a Swarm Mode that utilizes role-based dispatch and tmux-backed workers for agent coordination.
entries.xintaofei/codeg: Codeg is a collaborative workspace that aggregates sessions from fifteen built-in agents and custom ACP-compatible registrations. It can be deployed as a desktop app, standalone server, or Docker container, with native iOS and Android clients for remote connectivity.
entries.dodo-reach/hermes-desktop: Designed as a native Mac workspace, this tool provides direct local or SSH connections to Hermes hosts. It includes an embedded terminal for system repair and native views for managing sessions, Kanban boards, skills, and cron jobs.
entries.Eynzof/Hermes-CN-Desktop: Built with Tauri, TypeScript, and Rust, this Windows-first desktop application features native window and process management. It includes a built-in Hermes-CN-Core kernel with health check capabilities and a UI that renders LaTeX and Markdown.
entries.abundantbeing/hermes-browser-extension: This Chromium side-panel extension connects active browser context to local, cloud, or remote Hermes Agent runtimes. It allows for multi-agent profile switching and uses AI-assisted tab scoping to manage prompt context.
entries.uzairansaruzi/hermex: This native SwiftUI iPhone app pairs with a hermes-webui server to drive self-hosted agents from a mobile device. It supports real-time chat streaming with tool-call details, file attachments, and private push notifications via an open-source relay.
entries.freestylefly/wesight: Wesight is a desktop workspace offering one-click setup for engines like Hermes Agent and Claude Code alongside custom LLM model routing. It features a runtime dashboard for tracking token latency and a live workspace for monitoring code writes and diffs.
entries.joeynyc/hermes-hud: This interactive TUI serves as a consciousness monitor featuring nine tabs and four selectable color themes. It provides a tmux operator view for managing live agent panes while tracking agent growth, git projects, and scheduled cron jobs.
entries.xaspx/hermes-control-interface: This self-hosted web dashboard provides a browser-based terminal, file explorer, and an MCP server control plane for managing server lifecycles. It features real-time chat with tool call visualization and a ZOO Swarm Monitor for tracking agent health and kanban pipelines.
entries.jazzyalex/agent-sessions: A native macOS session browser that tracks per-session token burn and estimated API costs for Codex and Claude. It allows users to search prompts and tool calls across local histories and resume supported CLI sessions in Terminal.app, iTerm2, or Warp.
entries.nickvasilescu/hermes-desktop-os1: This native macOS interface facilitates one-click automated Hermes Agent installation on Orgo cloud VMs and SSH hosts. It includes an integrated WebRTC voice mode utilizing OpenAI Realtime and Orgo MCP.
entries.sharbelxyz/hermes-agent-mission-control: Built with Next.js 16 and Tailwind CSS v4, this dashboard template uses a Postgres message bus to bridge local agents with a web interface. It specifically features an approval inbox for managing agent requests that have side effects.
entries.liftaris/herm: Built with OpenTUI, this alternative interface provides a TUI for chatting and managing Hermes Agent sessions. It includes a kanban board for task management and supports the administration of profiles, skills, cron jobs, and toolsets.
entries.clawvader-tech/hermes-telegram-miniapp: This React-based Telegram Mini App provides a 10-page mobile-first UI with dual HMAC-SHA256 and Ed25519 authentication. It supports background agent spawning for up to five concurrent instances and includes a terminal chat with file attachment support.
entries.aivrar/portable-hermes-agent: This portable Windows desktop application runs via contained Python and Node.js environments without requiring admin rights or Docker. It features a built-in workflow engine and 100 tools for tasks including TTS, music generation, and ComfyUI image creation.
entries.pyrate-llama/hermes-ui: This glassmorphic web interface provides real-time log streaming and a task tracking dashboard for self-hosted AI assistants. It includes management tools for skills, cron jobs, and MCP servers alongside an integrated file browser.
entries.sanchomuzax/hermes-webui: This dashboard focuses on process monitoring by providing real-time session activity and cost tracking. It allows for the full inspection of conversation histories and skill source code, plus read-only monitoring of environment variables.
entries.Euraika-Labs/pan-ui: A chat-first workspace that utilizes real-time SSE streaming and tool approval cards for agent interactions. It features an integrated marketplace for skills and MCP servers, as well as isolated profile management for separate sessions and API keys.
entries.Felix-Forever/hermes-agent-desktop: This desktop client orchestrates collaboration between 20 specialized AI agents and includes a visual Skill Store with over 50 curated installations. The interface supports streaming SSE responses and allows for real-time model switching.
